depicts: A single bold horizontal stroke of ink drawn straight across the page.
commentary: One line, one count: the ancient form drew a single horizontal stroke, and that one stroke is the whole character for 'one'.

depicts: A single bold vertical stroke of ink drawn straight from top to bottom.
commentary: A single vertical stroke, drawn straight from top to bottom. As a radical it is simply the idea of a line — the plainest mark a brush can make.

depicts: A single bold dot of ink, like one heavy drop pressed from a brush.
commentary: One heavy drop of ink pressed from the brush. That single dot is the whole radical — a dot, a point, a pause.

depicts: A single sweeping slash of ink falling away down to the left.
commentary: Watch the slash sweep down to the left and taper away. That one falling stroke is the radical 丿 — a pure stroke shape, with no object behind it.

depicts: A young seedling bending sideways as it forces its way out of the soil in spring.
commentary: The ancient form drew a seedling bending sideways as it forces its way out of the soil. That bent sprout survives in the kinked single stroke of 乙.

depicts: A short barbed hook of ink, shaped like the tip of a fishhook.
commentary: A short barbed hook, shaped like the tip of a fishhook. Notice the barb at the end — that little catch is what makes the stroke a hook.

depicts: Two parallel horizontal strokes of ink, one set above the other.
commentary: Two parallel horizontal strokes, one set above the other: one line for one, two lines for two. The counting could not be plainer.

depicts: A short horizontal line with a small dot above it: the clipped top mark of a character, drawn boldly on its own as a plain sign.
commentary: Picture the very top of a character clipped off and standing on its own: a small dot over a short line. That little cap is the 亠 'lid' radical.

depicts: A person in profile: a bent back, one arm hanging down, and legs mid-stride.
commentary: The ancient form drew a person in profile — bent back, one arm hanging, legs mid-stride. Two strokes carry the whole walker: one for the body, one for the legs.

depicts: A small toddler: a big round head with a soft spot on top and little legs below.
commentary: A small toddler: a big round head with a soft spot on top and little legs below. The soft spot is still there in the short stroke at the top of 儿.

depicts: A pointed wedge driving downward into a ground line: the mark for entering.
commentary: See the pointed wedge driving downward into a ground line. A point entering a surface — that wedge going in is exactly the idea of 入, 'to enter'.

depicts: Two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two.
commentary: Two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two. Splitting apart is the picture behind 八.

depicts: An open upside-down U-shaped frame: the boundary line of open, empty country.
commentary: An upside-down U: an open frame with nothing inside it. The ancient form drew the boundary line of empty, open country — hence 'wide'.

depicts: A flat cloth draped over the top of an object, covering it completely.
commentary: A flat cloth draped over the top of an object, covering it completely. The top bar of 冖 is the cloth; the short sides are its hanging edges.

depicts: Two frozen drops of water turned to ice, drawn as two short cold strokes side by side.
commentary: Two frozen drops of water turned to ice, drawn as two short cold strokes side by side. When you see this pair at the left of a character, think ice and cold.

depicts: A small low table with short legs, drawn from the side.
commentary: A small low table with short legs, drawn from the side. The bent outline of 几 is the table's profile — top, then legs.

depicts: An open-mouthed pit in the ground: a U-shaped hollow receptacle.
commentary: An open-mouthed pit in the ground: a U-shaped hollow waiting to receive something. That hollow is the whole shape of 凵.

depicts: A curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle.
commentary: A curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle. The sweep of 刀 follows the curve of the cutting edge.

depicts: An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil.
commentary: The ancient form drew a plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil. Ploughing took power — so the tool became the sign for 'strength'.

depicts: A person bending over with both arms wrapping around a bundle, enclosing it.
commentary: A person bending over with both arms wrapping around a bundle, enclosing it. That wrapping embrace is the shape of 勹.

depicts: An ancient spoon or ladle with a shallow bowl and a short handle.
commentary: An ancient spoon or ladle: a shallow bowl and a short handle. The bowl sits in the curve of the stroke, the handle in its tail.

depicts: A square open box or basket seen from the side, its opening facing sideways.
commentary: A square open box seen from the side, its opening facing sideways. Three sides are drawn; the open side is where things go in.

depicts: An open rectangular box with one side missing, drawn as a simple bold outline.
commentary: Picture an open rectangular box drawn in a simple bold outline, one side missing. That plain container outline is the 匸 radical, the 'hiding enclosure'.

depicts: A vertical line crossed by a horizontal line: the complete tally mark for ten.
commentary: A vertical line crossed by a horizontal line: the complete tally mark. Crossing off the full count gives 十, ten.

depicts: A crack in a heated oracle bone: a vertical fissure with one short branch crack.
commentary: The ancient form drew a crack in a heated oracle bone: a vertical fissure with one short branch crack. Priests read the future in cracks like these — hence divination.

depicts: A kneeling person in profile, head bowed, with one leg folded under the body.
commentary: A kneeling person in profile, head bowed, one leg folded under the body. That folded, kneeling posture is packed into the few strokes of 卩.

depicts: A steep cliff face: one long slope dropping away from a top edge.
commentary: A steep cliff face: one long slope dropping away from a top edge. The flat top and the falling line of 厂 trace the cliff's profile.

depicts: A small neat triangle of ink: the clipped 'private' mark drawn plainly as a geometric sign.
commentary: Picture a small neat triangle of ink standing on its own. That plain geometric mark is the 厶 radical, the clipped sign read as 'private'.

depicts: A right hand seen from the side, its fingers curled as if gripping.
commentary: The ancient form drew a right hand from the side, fingers curled as if gripping. 又 began as the hand itself — the hand that reaches out 'again'.

depicts: An open mouth: one simple rounded square outline, nothing more.
commentary: An open mouth, and nothing more: one simple rounded square outline. The empty box of 口 is the mouth, wide open.

depicts: A complete square enclosure: four walls forming a closed pen or walled garden plot.
commentary: A complete square enclosure: four walls forming a closed pen or walled garden plot. Unlike a mouth, this box surrounds a whole space.

depicts: A mound of earth heaped up on a flat ground line, like a small altar of soil.
commentary: A mound of earth heaped up on a flat ground line, like a small altar of soil. The mound sitting on the ground is the cross you see in 土.

depicts: A robed scholar-official standing upright and holding a writing tablet.
commentary: Picture a robed scholar-official standing upright and holding a writing tablet. That dignified standing figure is the meaning picture for 士, the scholar.

depicts: A leg and foot arriving from above, stepping down as a person walks toward you.
commentary: A leg and foot arriving from above, stepping down as a person walks toward you. The downward-arriving step is frozen into the strokes of 夂.

depicts: A foot dragging slowly behind a leg: one slow, shuffling step.
commentary: A foot dragging slowly behind a leg: one slow, shuffling step. Watch how the foot trails — that heaviness is what 夊, 'go slowly', adds.

depicts: A crescent moon only half risen: the lower half of a crescent showing at dusk.
commentary: A crescent moon only half risen, its lower half showing at dusk. A half-seen moon is the picture for evening, 夕.

depicts: A person seen from the front, standing tall with arms stretched wide and legs apart.
commentary: A person seen from the front, standing tall with arms stretched wide and legs apart. To draw 'big', the ancient form drew a person taking up as much space as possible.

depicts: A woman kneeling in profile with her arms folded in front of her body.
commentary: The ancient form drew a woman kneeling in profile, her arms folded in front of her body. The crossed strokes of 女 still hold that kneeling figure.

depicts: A baby with a big head and waving arms, its lower body wrapped in swaddling clothes.
commentary: A baby with a big head and waving arms, its lower body wrapped in swaddling clothes. The big head dominates 子 just as it dominates the drawing.

depicts: A house roof seen from the front: a wide sloping roof with short walls dropping at both sides.
commentary: A house roof seen from the front: a wide sloping roof with short walls dropping at both sides. Anything sitting under this 'roof' radical is sheltered, indoors.

depicts: A hand with a small mark at the wrist showing the exact spot where the pulse is measured.
commentary: A hand with a small mark at the wrist, showing the exact spot where the pulse is measured. That measured spot on the body's own ruler gives 寸 its meaning, 'inch'.

depicts: Three tiny grains of sand lying side by side.
commentary: Three tiny grains of sand lying side by side. Grains almost too small to count one by one — that is the picture for 'small'.

depicts: A person standing with one leg bent and lame, leaning to one side.
commentary: A person standing with one leg bent and lame, leaning to one side. The lean of the figure is the whole story of 尢.

depicts: A squatting person seen from the side, body folded at the hips.
commentary: A squatting person seen from the side, body folded at the hips. 尸 keeps that crouched, folded silhouette.

depicts: A sprout breaking through the ground: a stem with two young leaves splitting upward.
commentary: A sprout breaking through the ground: a stem with two young leaves splitting upward. The upward fork of 屮 is the sprout's first split.

depicts: Three mountain peaks rising from one ground line, the middle peak the tallest.
commentary: Three mountain peaks rising from one ground line, the middle peak the tallest. The three uprights of 山 are the three peaks themselves.

depicts: Three streams of water flowing side by side down a slope.
commentary: Three streams of water flowing side by side down a slope. Tripled flowing water is the old river sign, 巛.

depicts: An ancient carpenter's square: a thick I-shaped measuring tool with notched ends.
commentary: An ancient carpenter's square: a thick I-shaped measuring tool with notched ends. The two horizontal bars of 工 are the tool's two ends.

depicts: A length of cord bent into a squared-off coil, partly unwound.
commentary: A length of cord bent into a squared-off coil, partly unwound. The squared loop of 己 follows the coiled cord.

depicts: A rectangular cloth hanging down from a horizontal strap, its lower edge loose.
commentary: A rectangular cloth hanging down from a horizontal strap, its lower edge loose. The strap is the top stroke of 巾; the hanging cloth is the rest.

depicts: A forked pole weapon used as a shield: a long shaft splitting into two prongs at the top.
commentary: The ancient form drew a forked pole weapon used as a shield: a long shaft splitting into two prongs at the top. 干 was this weapon long before it settled into meanings like 'dry'.

depicts: A short length of fine thread, drawn as one small twisted strand.
commentary: A short length of fine thread, drawn as one small twisted strand. Short and slight — the little strand itself explains why 幺 stands for a tiny unit.

depicts: A house built under a cliff: a wide sloping roof over an open front.
commentary: A house built under a cliff: a wide sloping roof over an open front. The one big slope of 广 is cliff face and roof in a single stroke.

depicts: A foot taking one long stretched stride along a path.
commentary: A foot taking one long stretched stride along a path. The extended lower stroke of 廴 stretches out like the stride itself.

depicts: Two hands raised side by side, palms up, offering something together.
commentary: Two hands raised side by side, palms up, offering something together. Two hands working as one pair — that is 廾.

depicts: A hunting arrow tied to a cord, shot to bring down birds and reel them in.
commentary: A hunting arrow tied to a cord, shot to bring down birds and reel them in. Look for the cord trailing from the arrow — that is the clever part of 弋.

depicts: A strung bow: a deeply curved bow with its string drawn straight down one side.
commentary: A strung bow: a deeply curved bow with its string drawn straight down one side. 弓 keeps both parts — the bent wood and the taut string.

depicts: A pig's snout seen from the front: a rounded snout with two nostrils.
commentary: A pig's snout seen from the front: a rounded snout with two nostrils. The squat, squared shape of 彐 is that snout, head-on.

depicts: Three long strands of hair or bristles flowing downward in parallel.
commentary: Three long strands of hair or bristles flowing downward in parallel. Those three sweeping strokes are pure decoration — 彡 adds flourish wherever it appears.

depicts: A foot taking a step at a crossroads: the walking-step mark.
commentary: A foot taking a step at a crossroads: the walking-step mark. 彳 is half of the crossroads picture, kept as the sign for a step.

depicts: A heart organ: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top.
commentary: The ancient form drew a heart: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top. The curves of 心 still trace the organ's outline.

depicts: A halberd: a long shaft topped with a horizontal dagger-blade.
commentary: A halberd: a long shaft topped with a horizontal dagger-blade. The blade juts sideways in 戈 exactly as it does on the weapon.

depicts: One single leaf of a door on its pivot post, seen from the front.
commentary: One single leaf of a door on its pivot post, seen from the front. One panel only — that single door is 戶, the household door.

depicts: An open hand with fingers spread, palm facing the viewer.
commentary: An open hand with fingers spread, palm facing the viewer. The short lines at the top of 手 are the fingers; the long sweep below is the palm and wrist.

depicts: A hand holding a bamboo branch that splits into twigs at the top.
commentary: A hand holding a bamboo branch that splits into twigs at the top. The splitting branch is the point of 支: a branch, and a support.

depicts: A hand gripping a stick and tapping downward with it.
commentary: A hand gripping a stick and tapping downward with it. The downward tap is the action frozen in 攴 — the striking hand.

depicts: A standing person seen from the front with decorative tattoo lines drawn across the chest.
commentary: A standing person seen from the front, with decorative tattoo lines drawn across the chest. Patterned marks came first; 文 moved from 'pattern' to the writing itself.

depicts: A ladle with a long handle and a scooped bowl, used for measuring grain.
commentary: A ladle with a long handle and a scooped bowl, used for measuring grain. The scooped bowl sits at the top of 斗, its handle trailing down.

depicts: An axe seen from the side: a broad curved blade mounted on a handle.
commentary: An axe seen from the side: a broad curved blade mounted on a handle. The heavy blade-head dominates 斤 just as it dominates the tool.

depicts: Two boat hulls lashed side by side into a raft, their bows tied together.
commentary: Two boat hulls lashed side by side into a raft, their bows tied together. Square and steady on the water, the raft stands behind 方's meanings of square and direction.

depicts: An open empty space with a single faint figure vanishing into it: a concept picture for 'nothing'.
commentary: Picture an open empty space with a single faint figure vanishing into it. That emptiness is the meaning picture for 无 — 'nothing, not'.

depicts: A ring for the sun: a circle with a short mark in its centre.
commentary: A ring for the sun: a circle with a short mark in its centre. The circle is the sun's disc, and the mark inside keeps it from being a plain ring.

depicts: A mouth with a short line above it marking the words coming out: speech being uttered.
commentary: A mouth with a short line above it, marking the words coming out: speech being uttered. 曰 is 'say' with the utterance still visible above the mouth.

depicts: A slim crescent moon with its horns pointing up and a short stroke inside the crescent.
commentary: A slim crescent moon with its horns pointing up and a short stroke inside the crescent. The crescent's curve forms the whole left side of 月.

depicts: A tree: a straight trunk, branches spreading up and out, and roots spreading down into the ground.
commentary: A tree: a straight trunk, branches spreading up and out, and roots spreading down into the ground. 木 keeps all three parts — spread at the top, spread at the bottom.

depicts: A person with mouth wide open, yawning, breath rising from the mouth.
commentary: A person with mouth wide open, yawning, breath rising from the mouth. That gaping mouth is the heart of 欠 — to yawn, to lack, to owe.

depicts: A foot planted flat on the ground, toes forward: the footprint that means stop.
commentary: A foot planted flat on the ground, toes forward: the footprint that means stop. A planted foot is a stopped foot.

depicts: Broken remains of bones: one cracked bone fragment lying on the ground.
commentary: Broken remains of bones: one cracked bone fragment lying on the ground. What is left of a skeleton is a grim picture — 歹 means bad, and death.

depicts: A hand gripping a long bamboo pike with a striking head.
commentary: A hand gripping a long bamboo pike with a striking head. Hand plus long weapon: 殳 is a pike built to strike.

depicts: A kneeling figure crossed by one bold line: the prohibition mark drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a kneeling figure crossed by one bold line, drawn plainly as a prohibition mark. The crossing line does the work: 毋 means 'do not'.

depicts: Two people standing side by side in a row, compared shoulder to shoulder.
commentary: Two people standing side by side in a row, compared shoulder to shoulder. Put two figures next to each other and you can compare them — that is 比.

depicts: A tuft of hair: fine strands bending over together from a root.
commentary: A tuft of hair: fine strands bending over together from a root. The strands' shared bend gives 毛 its soft, feathery sweep.

depicts: Several members of one family standing together under a single clan banner.
commentary: Picture several members of one family standing together under a single clan banner. One banner, one lineage — that is the meaning picture for 氏, 'clan'.

depicts: Three long wavy horizontal bands stacked one above another, like layers of drifting cloud or steam.
commentary: Three long wavy horizontal bands stacked one above another, like layers of drifting cloud or steam. Air on the move, drawn as three slow ripples, is 气.

depicts: A main stream flowing down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides.
commentary: A main stream flowing down the middle, with smaller streams splashing off to both sides. The central line of 水 is the river; the strokes at its sides are the spray.

depicts: A central flame tongue rising up with two smaller flames flickering out at its sides.
commentary: A central flame tongue rising up, with two smaller flames flickering out at its sides. The three tongues of the fire are still visible in 火.

depicts: A clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad.
commentary: A clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad. The downward press and the curve of the talons are packed into 爪.

depicts: A clear picture of father: the defining object or scene for the '父' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a father, drawn plainly as the senior figure of a family. That standing figure is the meaning picture for 父 — father.

depicts: A clear picture of diagrams: the defining object or scene for the '爻' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a small set of crossed lines, like a worked diagram. That neat tangle of line over line is the meaning picture for 爻, 'diagrams'.

depicts: A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward.
commentary: A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward. Half a log, flat side out — that is the whole of 爿.

depicts: A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward.
commentary: A log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward. 片 is that single flat slice of wood, cut from the round.

depicts: Upper and lower molar teeth meshing together, their cusped crowns interlocked.
commentary: Upper and lower molar teeth meshing together, their cusped crowns interlocked. Teeth that fit into each other like gears — that mesh is 牙.

depicts: A bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below.
commentary: A bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below. The horns crown 牛 just as they crown the animal.

depicts: A dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot marking its side.
commentary: A dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot marking its side. That little spot is the detail the character keeps — one dot beside the dog's body.

depicts: A skein of silk thread twisted into a loop and dyed dark.
commentary: A skein of silk thread twisted into a loop and dyed dark. Twisted and darkened thread gives 玄 its sense of the dark and mysterious.

depicts: Three flat jade tablets strung together on one vertical cord.
commentary: Three flat jade tablets strung together on one vertical cord. Read 玉 line by line: the three horizontal strokes are the tablets, the vertical stroke is the cord through them.

depicts: A round melon hanging from a curling vine with leaves.
commentary: A round melon hanging from a curling vine with leaves. The melon hangs in the middle of 瓜 just as it hangs from the vine.

depicts: A clear picture of tile: the defining object or scene for the '瓦' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a roof tile, drawn plainly as a single curved tile. That one tile is the meaning picture for 瓦 — the tiles that cover a roof.

depicts: A mouth holding something sweet: a mouth outline with a small morsel marked inside it.
commentary: A mouth holding something sweet: a mouth outline with a small morsel marked inside it. The little stroke inside the mouth of 甘 is the tasty thing itself.

depicts: A young shoot with two new leaves pushing up out of a line of soil.
commentary: A young shoot with two new leaves pushing up out of a line of soil. The soil is the ground line; the growth above it is 生 — life, growing.

depicts: A wooden bucket with a handle: a container in everyday use.
commentary: A wooden bucket with a handle: a container in everyday use. Plain and practical, the bucket is the picture for 'use'.

depicts: A rectangular field divided by crossing paths into four plots, like a paddy seen from above.
commentary: A rectangular field divided by crossing paths into four plots, like a paddy seen from above. The cross inside the box of 田 is those paths between the plots.

depicts: A rolled bolt of cloth standing upright with its loose end unrolling at the base.
commentary: Picture a rolled bolt of cloth standing upright, its loose end unrolling at the base. That roll of cloth is the meaning picture for 疋.

depicts: A person lying sick flat on a bed, body under a cover.
commentary: A person lying sick flat on a bed, body under a cover. The bed frames 疒 — everything resting on it is sickness.

depicts: Two footprints walking away side by side: left and right steps on a path.
commentary: Two footprints walking away side by side: left and right steps on a path. A matched pair of prints is the whole content of 癶, 'footsteps'.

depicts: A single grain of rice: a small pointed oval with one line marking its husk.
commentary: A single grain of rice: a small pointed oval with one line marking its husk. One white grain stands for 白, white itself.

depicts: A hand stripping a flayed animal hide, peeling it back by one corner.
commentary: A hand stripping a flayed animal hide, peeling it back by one corner. Skin in the act of being removed is the action frozen in 皮.

depicts: A shallow serving dish with a wide rim, seen from the side.
commentary: A shallow serving dish with a wide rim, seen from the side. The open, flat-bottomed shape of 皿 is the dish's profile.

depicts: An eye drawn on its side: an outline with the pupil as a mark in the middle.
commentary: An eye drawn on its side: an outline with the pupil as a mark in the middle. The box of 目 is the eye's frame, and the marks inside are the pupil.

depicts: A spear: a leaf-shaped spearhead mounted on a long straight shaft.
commentary: A spear: a leaf-shaped spearhead mounted on a long straight shaft. The head sits at the top of 矛; the shaft runs down its middle.

depicts: An arrow: a pointed metal head, a straight shaft, and feather fletching at the tail.
commentary: An arrow: a pointed metal head, a straight shaft, and feather fletching at the tail. Head at one end, feathers at the other — the arrow's two ends tell you what 矢 is.

depicts: A rounded boulder lying at the foot of a cliff overhang.
commentary: A rounded boulder lying at the foot of a cliff overhang. Cliff above, stone below — both halves of the scene are still readable in 石.

depicts: A sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board.
commentary: A sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board. Things set out before the spirits give 示 its senses of spirit and of showing.

depicts: An animal's footprint pressed into soft earth: a pad mark with toe prints.
commentary: An animal's footprint pressed into soft earth: a pad mark with toe prints. A track is a sign an animal leaves behind — that pressed mark is 禸.

depicts: A standing grain plant: a stalk with leaves and a heavy drooping ear of grain at the top.
commentary: A standing grain plant: a stalk with leaves and a heavy drooping ear of grain at the top. The ripe ear's droop bends the top of 禾.

depicts: A cave dwelling: an arched mound of earth with a dark entrance opening under its roof.
commentary: A cave dwelling: an arched mound of earth with a dark entrance opening under its roof. The arch is the cave mouth — 穴 is the hollow you shelter in.

depicts: A person standing squarely on a ground line, seen from the front.
commentary: A person standing squarely on a ground line, seen from the front. Feet planted on the line, body upright: 立 is standing itself.

depicts: Two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints.
commentary: Two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints. Bamboo is drawn doubled — one stalk alone would not say 竹.

depicts: Loose grains of rice as small dots clustered around a central husk on a stem.
commentary: Loose grains of rice as small dots clustered around a central husk on a stem. The dots are the rice; the cross beneath them is the plant they came from.

depicts: A skein of silk: fine threads twisted together and hanging from a small knot at the top.
commentary: A skein of silk: fine threads twisted together and hanging from a small knot at the top. The knot sits at the top of 糸; the threads fall below it.

depicts: An earthenware jar with a wide mouth and a rounded belly.
commentary: An earthenware jar with a wide mouth and a rounded belly. The jar's belly swells in the lower half of 缶.

depicts: A fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below.
commentary: A fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below. The crossed lines inside 网 are the mesh itself.

depicts: A sheep's head seen from the front: two curling horns, ears, and a pointed face below.
commentary: A sheep's head seen from the front: two curling horns, ears, and a pointed face below. The horns curl at the top of 羊 exactly as drawn.

depicts: Two long feathers side by side, each with a central quill and fine barbs along both sides.
commentary: Two long feathers side by side, each with a central quill and fine barbs along both sides. Feather doubled is 羽 — plumage, not a single feather.

depicts: An old man with long hair, bent over and leaning on a staff.
commentary: An old man with long hair, bent over and leaning on a staff. The bend of the back and the staff carry the whole meaning of 老.

depicts: A beard: strands of hair hanging down from a chin.
commentary: A beard: strands of hair hanging down from a chin. Those hanging strands, nothing more, are the original picture behind 而.

depicts: An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil.
commentary: An ancient plough: a long curved handle coming down to a forked share that bites into the soil. It is the same plough drawn for 力 — here the tool itself is the meaning.

depicts: An ear seen from the side: an outer rim, inner folds, and the ear opening.
commentary: An ear seen from the side: an outer rim, inner folds, and the ear opening. The layered lines inside 耳 follow the ear's own folds.

depicts: A hand holding a writing brush upright, its bristles pointing down at a surface.
commentary: A hand holding a writing brush upright, its bristles pointing down at a surface. Brush in hand and ready to write — 聿 is the pen at work.

depicts: A cut of meat: a chunk with the grain of flesh and fat drawn as lines inside it.
commentary: A cut of meat: a chunk with the grain of flesh and fat drawn as lines inside it. The inner lines of 肉 are the meat's own texture.

depicts: One eye drawn upright and vertical — the eye of a head bowed low in submission.
commentary: One eye drawn upright and vertical — the eye of a head bowed low in submission. A minister's watchful, lowered eye is the whole picture of 臣.

depicts: A nose seen from the front: the bridge, the two nostrils and the wings of the nose.
commentary: A nose seen from the front: the bridge, the two nostrils and the wings of the nose. The nose stood for the person themselves — 自 means 'self'.

depicts: An arrow flying downward and striking a horizontal ground line point-first.
commentary: An arrow flying downward and striking a horizontal ground line point-first. Arrival is the moment of impact: the arrow has reached its mark, and so has 至.

depicts: A clear picture of mortar: the defining object or scene for the '臼' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a mortar, the sturdy bowl that grain is pounded in. That heavy, hollow bowl is the meaning picture for 臼.

depicts: A tongue lolling out of an open mouth, its tip flicking upward.
commentary: A tongue lolling out of an open mouth, its tip flicking upward. The flicking tip raised above the mouth is what 舌 keeps.

depicts: Two feet pointing in opposite directions, stepping against each other.
commentary: Two feet pointing in opposite directions, stepping against each other. Feet working against each other give 舛 its meaning: contrary, at odds.

depicts: A boat from the side: a narrow hull with raised bow and stern and a line for its deck.
commentary: A boat from the side: a narrow hull with raised bow and stern and a line for its deck. The deck line runs through the middle of 舟.

depicts: A person turning the head to glare back over one shoulder while standing firm.
commentary: Picture a person turning the head to glare back over one shoulder while standing firm. That stubborn backward look, feet planted, is the meaning picture for 艮.

depicts: Three overlapping dabs of red, yellow and blue pigment on a painter's palette.
commentary: Picture three overlapping dabs of red, yellow and blue pigment on a painter's palette. Colour itself, dabbed and mixed, is the meaning picture for 色.

depicts: Two young grass sprouts pushing up side by side from the soil.
commentary: Two young grass sprouts pushing up side by side from the soil. Doubled sprouts stand for grass in general — that is 艸.

depicts: A tiger's head with bold striped markings, the body crouched behind it.
commentary: A tiger's head with bold striped markings, the body crouched behind it. The stripes do the work: 虍 is the tiger's striped head.

depicts: A snake rearing up: a triangular head with an eye on a thick body curving down into a tail.
commentary: The ancient form drew a snake rearing up: a triangular head with an eye on a thick body curving down into a tail. 虫 began as this snake-like creature before widening to insects and worms.

depicts: A shallow sacrificial dish with a single drop of blood in the middle of it.
commentary: A shallow sacrificial dish with a single drop of blood in the middle of it. The drop inside the dish is the point — 血 is the blood itself.

depicts: A crossroads seen from above: one road crossing another at right angles.
commentary: A crossroads seen from above: one road crossing another at right angles. That crossing of ways is 行 — roads, walking, going.

depicts: A robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below.
commentary: A robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below. Every part of the garment survives in 衣.

depicts: A clear picture of cover: the defining object or scene for the '襾' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a broad cover spread over the top of something, drawn plainly. That covering sheet is the meaning picture for 襾, 'cover'.

depicts: An eye on top of two legs: a figure whose head is one big watching eye.
commentary: An eye on top of two legs: a figure whose head is one big watching eye. Eye plus legs makes a person whose whole job is to see — that is 見.

depicts: An animal horn: thick and curved with ringed ridges along it, tapering to a point.
commentary: An animal horn: thick and curved, with ringed ridges along it, tapering to a point. The rings along the horn are drawn into 角 as its inner lines.

depicts: A mouth with sound lines rising inside it: words being spoken aloud.
commentary: A mouth with sound lines rising inside it: words being spoken aloud. The lines above the mouth in 言 are the sound coming out of it.

depicts: A clear picture of valley: the defining object or scene for the '谷' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a valley: two slopes falling away toward low ground between them. That dip between the hills is the meaning picture for 谷.

depicts: A stemmed serving bowl: a wide dish on a tall flared foot, with a raised rim.
commentary: A stemmed serving bowl: a wide dish on a tall flared foot, with a raised rim. The dish's tall foot is the stem at the bottom of 豆 — a serving vessel is the picture behind it.

depicts: A pig in profile: a round belly, a snout, a bristly back and a curly tail.
commentary: A pig in profile: a round belly, a snout, a bristly back and a curly tail. The bristles along the back are the detail to spot in 豕.

depicts: A badger-like beast standing in profile with a long striped back.
commentary: Picture a badger-like beast standing in profile with a long striped back. That sturdy creature is the meaning picture for 豸, the cat-like animal radical.

depicts: A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle.
commentary: A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle. The slit is the line you see running down the inside of 貝.

depicts: A standing person with flames rising at the feet: a figure in red heat.
commentary: A standing person with flames rising at the feet: a figure in red heat. Person above, fire below — glowing red is 赤.

depicts: A person running: arms swinging and one foot just leaving the ground.
commentary: A person running: arms swinging and one foot just leaving the ground. The motion lives in the upper figure; the strokes below are the stride hitting the ground.

depicts: A whole leg: a circle for the kneecap at the top, the shin below, and a foot at the bottom.
commentary: A whole leg: a circle for the kneecap at the top, the shin below, and a foot at the bottom. Read 足 downward and you read the leg itself, knee to foot.

depicts: A person in profile with a big swollen belly: a pregnant body.
commentary: A person in profile with a big swollen belly: a pregnant body. The bulge is the whole point — 身 is the body itself.

depicts: A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them.
commentary: A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them. From above, the wheels become the top and bottom lines of 車.

depicts: A sharp tattooing knife standing upright on its point.
commentary: A sharp tattooing knife standing upright on its point. A blade for marking and punishment — 辛 carries a bitter, harsh sting.

depicts: A clear picture of celestial stem: the defining object or scene for the '辰' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a plain bold sign standing for 辰, one of the old celestial stems of the calendar. The meaning picture here is the sign itself — a marker, not an object.

depicts: A clear picture of walk: the defining object or scene for the '辵' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a foot stepping along a road, caught mid-walk. That walking step is the meaning picture for 辵, the 'walk' radical.

depicts: A clear picture of city: the defining object or scene for the '邑' radical, drawn plainly.
commentary: Picture a small walled city: houses gathered together inside a boundary. That gathered settlement is the meaning picture for 邑, 'city'.

depicts: A wine jar with a narrow neck and a fat belly, marked with lines of fermenting brew.
commentary: A wine jar with a narrow neck and a fat belly, marked with lines of fermenting brew. The lines inside 酉 are the brew working inside the jar.

depicts: A hand picking single grains of rice out of a pile, sorting them one by one.
commentary: Picture a hand picking single grains of rice out of a pile, sorting them one by one. Sorting grain from grain — that careful picking is the meaning picture for 釆, 'distinguish'.

depicts: Farmland drawn above an earth mound with homes on it: fields and village together.
commentary: Farmland drawn above an earth mound with homes on it: fields and village together. Field over earth is 里 — the village among its fields.

depicts: Grains of metal ore dotted inside an earth mound under a cover: buried nuggets of metal.
commentary: Grains of metal ore dotted inside an earth mound under a cover: buried nuggets of metal. The dots in 金 are the nuggets hidden in the earth.

depicts: An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff.
commentary: An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff. The streaming hair is the point: length itself, in 長.

depicts: A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame.
commentary: A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame. Two panels side by side make 門 — twice the single door of 戶.

depicts: A hillside cut into a staircase of earthen ledges rising step by step.
commentary: A hillside cut into a staircase of earthen ledges rising step by step. The stacked ledges of the hillside are the steps you still see stacked in 阜.

depicts: A servant bowing and following behind a master, carrying a bundle.
commentary: Picture a servant bowing and following behind a master, carrying a bundle. Following and serving — that trailing figure is the meaning picture for 隶, 'slave'.

depicts: A short-tailed bird in profile: a plump body, a beak and a small fan of tail feathers.
commentary: A short-tailed bird in profile: a plump body, a beak and a small fan of tail feathers. The short tail is the giveaway — 隹 is the short-tailed bird.

depicts: A line of sky at the top, a band of cloud under it, and four raindrops falling through the air.
commentary: A line of sky at the top, a band of cloud under it, and four raindrops falling through the air. The four drops inside 雨 are the rain itself, caught mid-fall.

depicts: Green shoots sprouting above a round well of pigment: growing plants over a circle of colour.
commentary: Green shoots sprouting above a round well of pigment: growing plants over a circle of colour. Growth plus pigment gives 靑, the blue-green of young leaves and dye.

depicts: Two figures standing back to back, turned away from each other in opposition.
commentary: Two figures standing back to back, turned away from each other in opposition. Facing away from each other is opposition drawn literally — that is 非, 'not'.

depicts: A human face drawn full-on: an outline of a face with one eye in the middle.
commentary: A human face drawn full-on: an outline of a face with one eye in the middle. The eye sits at the centre of 面 just as it sits in the drawing.

depicts: A flayed animal hide stretched out flat: the head at the top and legs splayed at the corners.
commentary: A flayed animal hide stretched out flat: the head at the top and legs splayed at the corners. Skin stretched for working is leather in the making — that is 革.

depicts: A finished sheet of soft tanned leather, rolled up.
commentary: Picture a finished sheet of soft tanned leather, rolled up. Soft and processed — that roll of leather is the meaning picture for 韋.

depicts: Leeks growing in a row: long flat green blades rising from a bed of soil.
commentary: Leeks growing in a row: long flat green blades rising from a bed of soil. The blades stand in a row in 韭 just as they grow in the bed.

depicts: A mouth with one line marking the sound inside it: a single note being produced.
commentary: A mouth with one line marking the sound inside it: a single note being produced. The mark inside is the sound — 音 is that note made visible.

depicts: A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head — the head is the whole point of the picture.
commentary: A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head — the head is the whole point of the picture. That outsized head is what 頁 is about.

depicts: Trees bending and clouds streaming sideways across the sky, driven by a strong wind.
commentary: Picture trees bending and clouds streaming sideways across the sky, driven by a strong wind. You never see the wind itself, only what it moves — that is the meaning picture for 風.

depicts: A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it.
commentary: A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it. Wings up, feathers back: 飛 is flight at full stretch.

depicts: A covered serving dish heaped with food: a meal waiting under its lid.
commentary: A covered serving dish heaped with food: a meal waiting under its lid. The lid riding on top of 食 covers the meal beneath.

depicts: A head with a full mass of hair on top, hair strokes rising above the face.
commentary: A head with a full mass of hair on top, hair strokes rising above the face. Hair first, face below: the head, whole and plain, is 首.

depicts: A grain plant standing over a mouth: the sweet fragrance of ripe grain being tasted.
commentary: A grain plant standing over a mouth: the sweet fragrance of ripe grain being tasted. Grain above, mouth below — sweetness smelled and tasted is 香.

depicts: A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail.
commentary: A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail. The mane's crest and the flowing tail are the strokes to trace in 馬.

depicts: A jointed bone with its two knuckle ends, a strip of flesh still on it.
commentary: A jointed bone with its two knuckle ends, a strip of flesh still on it. The knuckle ends cap the bone just as they cap the strokes of 骨.

depicts: A tall watchtower: a roofed building with a doorway, raised on a high platform.
commentary: A tall watchtower: a roofed building with a doorway, raised on a high platform. Height is built into the picture itself — 高 is tall by construction.

depicts: Very long hair streaming down from a head in waves past the shoulders.
commentary: Very long hair streaming down from a head in waves past the shoulders. Hair and more hair: 髟 is nothing but long hair flowing.

depicts: Two fighters facing off with raised arms on either side of a gate.
commentary: Two fighters facing off with raised arms on either side of a gate. Opponents squared up across a doorway — 鬥 is a fight about to start.

depicts: A bundle of fragrant herbs steeping in a cup of sacrificial wine.
commentary: A bundle of fragrant herbs steeping in a cup of sacrificial wine. Herbs plus wine, aroma rising: that steeping cup is 鬯.

depicts: A tripod cooking pot: a round-bellied cauldron standing on three hollow legs.
commentary: A tripod cooking pot: a round-bellied cauldron standing on three hollow legs. The three legs hold up 鬲 just as they hold up the pot.

depicts: A ghost figure: a big masked head on a swirling body with clawed feet.
commentary: A ghost figure: a big masked head on a swirling body with clawed feet. The oversized head looms over 鬼 just as it looms in the picture.

depicts: A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail.
commentary: A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail. Read 魚 from top to bottom and you travel from the head to the tail.

depicts: A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet.
commentary: A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet. Every part of the perched bird survives somewhere in 鳥.

depicts: White salt crystals glittering in a heap inside a shallow pan.
commentary: White salt crystals glittering in a heap inside a shallow pan. The glittering heap in the pan is the point — 鹵 is salt, gathered and piled.

depicts: A deer in profile: a head crowned with big branching antlers, a slim body and four thin legs.
commentary: A deer in profile: a head crowned with big branching antlers, a slim body and four thin legs. The antlers branch at the top of 鹿 just as they branch on the deer.

depicts: A stalk of wheat with its ear of grain at the top and roots below.
commentary: A stalk of wheat with its ear of grain at the top and roots below. Grain above, roots below — 麥 keeps the whole plant.

depicts: Tall hemp plants with serrated leaves growing in a row under a shelter.
commentary: Tall hemp plants with serrated leaves growing in a row under a shelter. Hemp grown under a roof, ready to be worked into fibre — that is 麻.

depicts: A heap of golden-yellow earth and ripe grain glowing under a bright sun.
commentary: Picture a heap of golden-yellow earth and ripe grain glowing under a bright sun. Yellowness itself, heaped and glowing, is the meaning picture for 黃.

depicts: A stalk of millet with a heavy drooping head of grains.
commentary: A stalk of millet with a heavy drooping head of grains. The heavy head bends 黍 at the top, weighed down with grain.

depicts: Soot and smoke rising from a fire and blackening the underside of a cover above it.
commentary: Soot and smoke rising from a fire and blackening the underside of a cover above it. Black is what the smoke leaves behind — that dark stain is 黑.

depicts: A needle pulling coloured thread through a piece of cloth in a neat stitched pattern.
commentary: Picture a needle pulling coloured thread through a piece of cloth in a neat stitched pattern. Stitch by stitch the pattern grows — that needlework is the meaning picture for 黹.

depicts: A frog seen from above: a round body, a wide head and splayed hind legs.
commentary: A frog seen from above: a round body, a wide head and splayed hind legs. From above, the splayed legs frame 黽 on both sides.

depicts: A bronze tripod cauldron: a round belly, two handles on the rim, and three sturdy legs.
commentary: A bronze tripod cauldron: a round belly, two handles on the rim, and three sturdy legs. Handles above, legs below — 鼎 keeps the cauldron's full silhouette.

depicts: A drum on a stand, with a hand holding a drumstick striking its skin.
commentary: A drum on a stand, with a hand holding a drumstick striking its skin. Drum plus the hand that beats it: 鼓 includes its own drummer.

depicts: A rat in profile: pointed snout with whiskers and teeth, round ears, a plump body, little feet and a long thin tail.
commentary: A rat in profile: pointed snout with whiskers and teeth, round ears, a plump body, little feet and a long thin tail. The long tail trails out of 鼠 last, as it should.

depicts: A nose drawn large from the front, with two clear nostrils, above a breathing passage.
commentary: A nose drawn large from the front, with two clear nostrils, above a breathing passage. The two nostrils are marked inside 鼻 — breathe through it, and you have the picture.

depicts: Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height.
commentary: Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height. Evenness you can check at a glance: level tops are the whole meaning of 齊.

depicts: A row of teeth inside an open mouth, the molars marked in a line.
commentary: A row of teeth inside an open mouth, the molars marked in a line. The teeth sit in a row inside 齒 just as they sit in the mouth.

depicts: A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail.
commentary: A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail. Head above, body coiling below — 龍 rises the same way.

depicts: A tortoise seen from the side: a domed shell, a head with an eye, and clawed legs.
commentary: A tortoise seen from the side: a domed shell, a head with an eye, and clawed legs. The domed shell rounds the top of 龜 just as it rounds the animal.

depicts: A set of panpipes: bamboo tubes of different lengths bound in a row, mouth holes at the top.
commentary: A set of panpipes: bamboo tubes of different lengths bound in a row, mouth holes at the top. The uneven row of tube tops is drawn into 龠 — many lengths, one instrument.

depicts: The man, person component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a person in profile: a bent back, one arm hanging down, and legs mid-stride.
commentary: 亻 (rén, person) — a person in profile: bent back, one arm hanging down, legs mid-stride. This is 人 squeezed into its narrow left-side form, so look for the striding figure inside a character.

depicts: The knife component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle.
commentary: 刂 (dāo, knife) — a curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle, standing upright. It is 刀 compressed into the right-side form, keeping just the blade's curve.

depicts: The knife component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a curved single-edged knife blade with a short handle.
commentary: ⺈ (dāo, knife) — the same curved knife blade as 刂, cut down to a small form that sits at the top of a character. Either way, a bare blade means knife.

depicts: A heart drawn as a narrow vertical shape with its vessels at the top: the heart in its compressed left-side form.
commentary: 忄 (xīn, heart) — a heart drawn as a narrow vertical shape with its vessels at the top. It is 心 in its squeezed left-side form, tall and thin to fit beside another component.

depicts: The heart component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a heart organ: a rounded sac with the great vessels curving out of its top.
commentary: ⺗ (xīn, heart) — a rounded heart sac with the great vessels curving out of its top. This is 心 in its bottom form, sitting underneath the rest of the character.

depicts: One single leaf of a door — half of a double gate — with its pivot post.
commentary: 户 (hù, door) — one single leaf of a door on its pivot post: half of a double gate. Inside characters it is 戶 reduced to that one leaf, still meaning door or household.

depicts: A hand with fingers curled to grip, squeezed into its narrow left-side form.
commentary: 扌 (shǒu, hand) — a hand with its fingers curled as if gripping something. It is 手 narrowed into the left-side form, which is why it turns up in so many action words.

depicts: The tap component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a hand gripping a stick and tapping downward with it.
commentary: 攵 (pū, tap) — a hand gripping a stick and tapping downward with it. As the compressed right-side form of 攴, it carries a sense of striking or doing.

depicts: Three droplets of water in a vertical column, splashing downward: water in its compressed left-side form.
commentary: 氵 (shuǐ, water) — three droplets of water in a vertical column, splashing downward. This is 水 squeezed into the left-side form, reduced to three drops.

depicts: The water component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a main stream flowing down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides.
commentary: 氺 (shuǐ, water) — a main stream flowing down the middle with smaller streams splashing off to both sides. It is 水 in the form it takes at the bottom of a character.

depicts: Four dots of flame in a row under a character: fire reduced to its four-dot bottom form.
commentary: 灬 (huǒ, fire) — four dots of flame in a row. This is 火 reduced to its bottom form: just the flames under whatever sits above them.

depicts: The claw component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a clawed foot pressing down: sharp talons curving out of a pad.
commentary: 爫 (zhǎo, claw) — a clawed foot pressing down, sharp talons curving out of a pad. It is 爪 in its compressed top form, reaching over the component below.

depicts: The half tree trunk component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a log split lengthwise: one half of a trunk with its flat split face forward.
commentary: 丬 (pán, half tree trunk) — a log split lengthwise, one half of the trunk with its flat split face forward. It is 爿 narrowed for the left side: half a trunk standing upright.

depicts: The cow component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below.
commentary: 牜 (niú, cow) — a bull's head seen from the front: two curved horns, ears at the sides, and a muzzle below. This is 牛 in its left-side form.

depicts: The dog component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot marking its side.
commentary: 犭 (quǎn, dog) — a dog standing in profile: pointed ears, a long snout, a curled tail, and a spot on its side. It is 犬 squeezed into the left-side form, still clearly an animal.

depicts: Three flat jade tablets strung on one vertical cord, drawn in the narrow left-side form this component takes inside characters.
commentary: 王 (yù, jade) — three flat jade tablets strung on one vertical cord. Inside characters this narrow left-side form is 玉, and the three even tablets are the giveaway.

depicts: The spirit, show component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board.
commentary: 礻 (shì, spirit) — a sacrificial altar: a table-like stand with offerings hanging from its top board. It is 示 compressed for the left side, pointing to spirits and ritual.

depicts: The bamboo component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints.
commentary: ⺮ (zhú, bamboo) — two bamboo stalks side by side, each with pointed leaves drooping from its upper joints. This is 竹 flattened into the top form.

depicts: The silk component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a skein of silk: fine threads twisted together and hanging from a small knot at the top.
commentary: 纟 (mì, silk) — a skein of silk: fine threads twisted together and hanging from a small knot at the top. It is 糸 in its simplified left-side form.

depicts: The net component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below.
commentary: 罒 (wǎng, net) — a fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below. It is 网 compressed into the top form, the mesh kept as a simple grid.

depicts: The net component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a fishing net hung open: a straight top edge with a mesh of crossed lines below.
commentary: ⺳ (wǎng, net) — the same open fishing net as 罒: a straight top edge over a mesh of crossed lines. Either net form sits on top of a character, and the crossed mesh is what to spot.

depicts: Two young grass sprouts side by side, in the short top form this component takes inside characters.
commentary: 艹 (cǎo, grass) — two young grass sprouts side by side. This is the short top form of 艸, and the pair of sprouts is the sign for plants and herbs.

depicts: The clothes component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below.
commentary: 衤 (yī, clothes) — a robe with wide sleeves: a collar crossing at the neck, sleeves hanging at both sides, and a skirt below. It is 衣 split open into its left-side form.

depicts: The speech component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a mouth with sound lines rising inside it: words being spoken aloud.
commentary: 讠 (yán, speech) — a mouth with sound lines rising inside it: words being spoken aloud. It is 言 in its simplified left-side form, marking anything to do with speech.

depicts: The gold, metal component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on grains of metal ore dotted inside an earth mound under a cover: buried nuggets of metal.
commentary: 钅 (jīn, metal) — grains of metal ore dotted inside an earth mound under a cover: buried nuggets of metal. It is 金 in its simplified left-side form, the sign for metals.

depicts: The eat component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a covered serving dish heaped with food: a meal waiting under its lid.
commentary: 饣 (shí, eat) — a covered serving dish heaped with food: a meal waiting under its lid. It is 食 in its simplified left-side form.

depicts: A hillside cut into a staircase of earthen ledges: the mound form that stands at the left or right of a character. (This same shape also serves 邑 'city' on the right side.)
commentary: 阝 (fù, mound) — a hillside cut into a staircase of earthen ledges. On the left it is 阜, the mound; the same shape on the right serves 邑, city — position tells you which.

depicts: A foot stepping onto a winding path, drawn in the sweeping walk-form that wraps under a character.
commentary: 辶 (chuò, walk) — picture a foot stepping onto a winding path that sweeps underneath the character. It is a meaning picture for walking and movement, in the wrap-around form of 辵.

depicts: A cut of meat with the grain of flesh drawn inside it, in the narrow left-side form this component takes inside characters.
commentary: ⺼ (ròu, meat) — a cut of meat with the grain of the flesh drawn inside it. It is 肉 in its narrow left-side form, which is why so many body-part characters carry it.

depicts: The old component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on an old man with long hair, bent over and leaning on a staff.
commentary: 耂 (lǎo, old) — an old man with long hair, bent over and leaning on a staff. This is 老 in its compressed top form.

depicts: The small component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on three tiny grains of sand lying side by side.
commentary: ⺌ (xiǎo, small) — three tiny grains of sand lying side by side. It is 小 compressed for the top of a character: smallness reduced to specks.

depicts: The small component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on three tiny grains of sand lying side by side.
commentary: ⺍ (xiǎo, small) — the same three tiny grains of sand as ⺌: smallness drawn as mere specks. Whichever small form tops the character, the meaning is the same.

depicts: The eight component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two.
commentary: 丷 (bā, eight) — two strokes splitting away from each other, like something being divided in two. It is 八 in its compressed top form, the split still visible.

depicts: The short thread component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a short length of fine thread, drawn as one small twisted strand.
commentary: 么 (yāo, short thread) — one small twisted strand of fine thread, drawn on its own. It is 幺 in its simplified form: a single short thread.

depicts: Three long parallel streams of water flowing downward side by side.
commentary: 川 (chuān, river) — three long parallel streams of water flowing downward side by side. As the form 巛 takes inside characters, it keeps all three currents in view.

depicts: The lame component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a person standing with one leg bent and lame, leaning to one side.
commentary: 尣 (wāng, lame) — a person standing with one leg bent and lame, leaning to one side. It is 尢 in a compressed form, and the uneven stance does the talking.

depicts: The seal component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a kneeling person in profile, head bowed, with one leg folded under the body.
commentary: 㔾 (jié, seal) — a kneeling person in profile, head bowed, with one leg folded under the body. It is 卩 in a compressed form: a figure folded into a kneel.

depicts: The bad, death component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on broken remains of bones: one cracked bone fragment lying on the ground.
commentary: 歺 (dǎi, bad, death) — the broken remains of bones: one cracked bone fragment lying on the ground. It is 歹 in its right-side form, stripped down to a single fragment.

depicts: The divination component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a crack in a heated oracle bone: a vertical fissure with one short branch crack.
commentary: ⺊ (bǔ, divination) — a crack in a heated oracle bone: a vertical fissure with one short branch crack. It is 卜 in a compressed form, still a fortune-teller's crack.

depicts: The ice component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on two frozen drops of water turned to ice, drawn as two short cold strokes side by side.
commentary: ⺀ (bīng, ice) — two frozen drops of water turned to ice, drawn as two short cold strokes side by side. This is the ice component 冫 in another compressed form: two drops, already frozen.

depicts: The pen component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a hand holding a writing brush upright, its bristles pointing down at a surface.
commentary: 肀 (yù, pen) — a hand holding a writing brush upright, its bristles pointing down at a surface. It is 聿 in its compressed bottom form, ready to write.

depicts: The see component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on an eye on top of two legs: a figure whose head is one big watching eye.
commentary: 见 (jiàn, see) — an eye on top of two legs: a figure whose head is one big watching eye. It is 見 in simplified form, and the eye does the seeing.

depicts: A cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle.
commentary: 贝 (bèi, shell) — a cowrie shell: an oval shell with a serrated slit running down its middle. That slit is the detail to look for in 貝's simplified form.

depicts: A cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them.
commentary: 车 (chē, cart) — a cart seen from above: two big wheels, an axle, a shaft, and the box of the cart between them. The top-down view is the whole trick of this picture for 車.

depicts: A double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame.
commentary: 门 (mén, gate) — a double-leaf gate: two door panels hanging in a frame. It is 門 in simplified form, with both leaves still in the picture.

depicts: A kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head — the head is the whole point of the picture.
commentary: 页 (yè, page) — a kneeling person drawn with a greatly oversized head: the head is the whole point of the picture. In 頁's simplified form, that big head is what to remember.

depicts: A perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet.
commentary: 鸟 (niǎo, bird) — a perched bird in profile: crested head with beak and eye, folded wing, tail feathers and clawed feet. It is 鳥 simplified, with every part of the bird still there.

depicts: A fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail.
commentary: 鱼 (yú, fish) — a fish in profile: triangular head with mouth and eye, a scaled body, fins, and a forked tail. It is 魚 in simplified form, swimming exactly as drawn.

depicts: A horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail.
commentary: 马 (mǎ, horse) — a horse in profile facing left: crested mane, one visible eye, four legs and a long flowing tail. It is 馬 simplified, and the mane and tail do the work.

depicts: A dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail.
commentary: 龙 (lóng, dragon) — a dragon rearing up: a horned head with open jaws at the top of a long serpentine body ending in a tail. It is 龍 in simplified form.

depicts: Three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height.
commentary: 齐 (qí, even, neat) — three heads of grain standing in a row, all grown to exactly the same height. Evenness is the picture: 齊 simplified, with nothing sticking up higher than the rest.

depicts: The tooth component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a row of teeth inside an open mouth, the molars marked in a line.
commentary: 齿 (chǐ, tooth) — a row of teeth inside an open mouth, the molars marked in a line. It is 齒 in its simplified form: look for the row of teeth.

depicts: The tanned leather component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a finished sheet of soft tanned leather, rolled up.
commentary: 韦 (wéi, tanned leather) — picture a finished sheet of soft tanned leather, rolled up. It is a meaning picture for 韋's simplified form: a roll of supple hide.

depicts: The wind component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on trees bending and clouds streaming sideways across the sky, driven by a strong wind.
commentary: 风 (fēng, wind) — picture trees bending and clouds streaming sideways across the sky, driven by a strong wind. It is a meaning picture for 風's simplified form: nothing in it stands still.

depicts: A bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it.
commentary: 飞 (fēi, fly) — a bird in flight, wings spread wide and tail feathers streaming behind it. It is 飛 simplified, caught mid-flight.

depicts: The salty component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on white salt crystals glittering in a heap inside a shallow pan.
commentary: 卤 (lǔ, salty) — white salt crystals glittering in a heap inside a shallow pan. It is 鹵 in its simplified form: the salt itself, piled up.

depicts: The wheat component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a stalk of wheat with its ear of grain at the top and roots below.
commentary: 麦 (mài, wheat) — a stalk of wheat with its ear of grain at the top and roots below. It is 麥 in simplified form: the whole plant, root to ear.

depicts: The yellow component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a heap of golden-yellow earth and ripe grain glowing under a bright sun.
commentary: 黄 (huáng, yellow) — picture a heap of golden-yellow earth and ripe grain glowing under a bright sun. It is a meaning picture for 黃's simplified form: the colour itself, heaped up.

depicts: The frog component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on a frog seen from above: a round body, a wide head and splayed hind legs.
commentary: 黾 (měng, frog) — a frog seen from above: a round body, a wide head and splayed hind legs. It is 黽 in simplified form, and the view from above is what makes it readable.

depicts: The blue-green component in its compressed positional form, drawn as it appears inside characters: based on green shoots sprouting above a round well of pigment: growing plants over a circle of colour.
commentary: 青 (qīng, blue-green) — green shoots sprouting above a round well of pigment: growing plants over a circle of colour. As the form 靑 takes inside characters, sprouts plus pigment give the colour of new growth.

depicts: An old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff.
commentary: 长 (cháng, long) — an old man with very long hair streaming behind him, leaning on a walking staff. It is 長 simplified: the length is in the hair.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Shears, for cultivating a garden (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 乂 (yì, to govern) — Two blades cross like garden shears, trimming growth into order. Cutting back and ordering is governing, managing.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'seven': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 七 (qī, seven) — Picture a simple counting scene for seven. Use the number picture as a meaning cue for qī.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: One stroke on top of another; compare 下 (below) (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 上 (shàng, above) — A short stroke sits above a longer base line, the upper mark picked out as the indicator. Position is the meaning: above, the opposite of below.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient pictographic form: A nail (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 丁 (dīng, male adult) — the ancient picture is simply a nail: a round head with the point driven down below it. That plain nail is the whole glyph.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Cutting 一 off the feet 儿 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 兀 (wù, weak) — The ancient compound shows a figure left unsteady on a flat base, without feet to stand firmly. With no firm footing, the figure is weak and tottering.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: One stroke under another; compare 上 (above) (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 下 (xià, below) — A short stroke hangs below a longer base line, the lower mark picked out as the indicator. Position is the meaning: below, the opposite of above.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'the hours from 9 to 11': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 巳 (sì, the hours from 9 to 11) — Picture a clock or morning marker for the 9-to-11 hours. Use it as a plain time cue for sì.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient pictographic form: A child swaddled in blanklets; compare 子 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 了 (le) — the ancient picture is a small child wrapped up tight in swaddling blankets. Compare it with 子, the child.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'to assemble': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 亼 (jí, to assemble) — picture people gathering together under one roof into a single group. A modern meaning picture, not an ancient form.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: The heavens 一 above a man 大 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 天 (tiān, sky) — A line of heaven stretches above a standing person. What is over the person's head is the sky.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: A knife 勹 cutting fragments 丿 off (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 勿 (wù, must not) — A knife cuts and scatters small fragments aside. The cutting-away gesture carries the prohibition: must not.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Three  parallel lines; compare 一 (one) and 二 (two) (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 三 (sān, three) — Three parallel lines are stacked in a row. Count them as you would one line for one and two lines for two: three lines, three.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'thousand': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 千 (qiān, thousand) — Picture a large counting scene for a thousand, far beyond a handful. Use the scale of the number as the cue for qiān.

depicts: A clan banner: a tall pole planted in a base, with long streamers flying from its top.
commentary: 中 (zhōng, central) — A tall banner pole stands planted in its base, streamers flying from the top. The pole marks the centre point everyone gathers around.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Words passing through ten 十 mouths 口 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 古 (gǔ, old) — words pass from mouth to mouth through ten generations. Speech handed down ten mouths over: ancient, old.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Two tens 十 side by side (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 卄 (niàn, twenty) — Two ten-signs stand side by side. Add ten and ten together in the picture and you get twenty.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: The sun 日 rising over the horizon 一 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 旦 (dàn, dawn) — the sun sits right on the horizon line, just risen. Sun over the flat line of the earth: dawn.

depicts: A sacrificial stand seen from the front: a flat top carried on legs, like a small altar table.
commentary: 且 (qiě, moreover) — A sacrificial stand seen from the front, with a flat top on legs like a small altar table. That stand shape is the ancient core of the glyph.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Two tens 十 side by side (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 廿 (niàn, twenty) — Two tens are joined side by side in one compact sign. Count both tens to read the number twenty.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'that which': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 者 (zhě, that which) — Picture a plain pointer to 'the one who' or 'that which' does something. Use it as a grammatical meaning cue for zhě.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'may': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 可 (kě, may) — picture a nod of permission: yes, you may. A modern meaning picture, not an ancient form.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'still': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 尚 (shàng, still) — Picture something still continuing, not yet finished. Use that ongoing state as the meaning cue for shàng.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Road 丨 leading to the farm 田 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 由 (yóu, cause) — A road runs out toward a farm field. Follow the road to where it leads: the route gives the origin, the cause.

depicts: Three young grass shoots sprouting in a row from a single ground stem.
commentary: 丰 (fēng, abundant) — three young grass shoots sprout in a row from a single ground stem. Shoot after shoot: growth in abundance.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: One person 人 following another (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 从 (cóng, from) — one person follows right behind another. Following along behind someone: from, following.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: Older brother 儿 speaking 口 to younger ones (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 兄 (xiōng, elder brother) — A mouth speaks above a pair of legs: the older brother addressing the younger ones. The speaking senior is the elder brother.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'to combine': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 合 (hé, to combine) — picture two halves of a lidded box closing together into one. A modern meaning picture, not an ancient form.

depicts: Drawn from the ancient compound (ideographic) form: A man 大 wearing a coming-of-age hairpin 一 (shown as the scene itself, plainly drawn).
commentary: 夫 (fū, man) — a grown man stands tall with a hairpin across the top of his head. The hairpin marks the coming of age: an adult man.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'to rotate': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 帀 (zā, to rotate) — Picture something turning full circle, rotating around once. Use the turning motion as the meaning cue for zā.

depicts: A plain modern picture representing 'business': the clearest everyday object or scene for this meaning, drawn simply.
commentary: 业 (yè, business) — Picture a workplace or line of business in a plain modern scene. Use it as the meaning cue for yè.

depicts: A bent arm: upper arm and forearm folded at the elbow, reaching out.
commentary: 九 (jiǔ, nine) — a bent arm, folded at the elbow and reaching out. That bent arm is the ancient picture behind the strokes.
